known_limitations: Wikipedia membership change table publishes only effective dates, so universe availability uses effective_date itself (a later, conservative instant); an announced-but-not-yet-effective change is never granted membership early

EODHD publishes NO delisting returns of any kind; a security whose prices stop before the window end therefore has an UNKNOWN terminal return and its forward label is unobservable. omitting the delisting return biases forward returns UPWARD for bankruptcies and DOWNWARD/no-effect for cash acquisitions; the direction depends on the termination kind and cannot be assumed away
EODHD exposes no permanent security id and no CIK; identity is resolved from name/exchange/date evidence with an explicit unresolved-identities artifact

Wikipedia change-table coverage is uneven before the mid-2000s; several well-known failures (Bear Stearns, Enron, WaMu, Circuit City) are absent and are therefore not provable as members from this source
proven failed/removed firms in this build: LEH, WB, AIG
manifest.notes: WP2B survivorship-controlled S&P 500 PIT monthly panel
